> **Key answer**: This article will cover the use and acceptance checks for abrasion-resistant foil across gift-box design, assembly and distribution. PINTE product information states that this wear-resistant series can achieve approximately 200 rub cycles under a 4 lb weighted test without obvious colour loss or obvious metallic-layer loss. The statement should be confirmed against the actual sample and technical report.

## Main risks in the application

cover the use and acceptance checks for abrasion-resistant foil across gift-box design, assembly and distribution. For seasonal gift boxes, corporate gift packaging, luxury boxes and collectible boxed products, the stamped surface may experience die-cutting, folding, assembly, stacking, transport and consumer handling. Premium packaging has a narrow tolerance for local flaking, feathered edges or gloss changes. Foil selection should therefore consider appearance, adhesion, abrasion resistance and production repeatability together.

## Why should the actual packaging material be sampled?

specialty paper, textured paper, laminated paper, soft-touch paper and coated paper may vary in coating, ink, lamination, texture and surface energy. Results from ordinary coated paper cannot be transferred directly to soft-touch, specialty or laminated substrates. Use the production paper, printing method, surface treatment, die and machine whenever possible.

## How should the 4 lb rub test be understood?

PINTE product information states that this wear-resistant series can achieve approximately 200 rub cycles under a 4 lb weighted test without obvious colour loss or obvious metallic-layer loss. The statement should be confirmed against the actual sample and technical report.

## Selection and sampling recommendations

1. Confirm whether the packaging has tactile coating, matte film, gloss film, varnish or special ink.

1. Identify the artwork structure: solid areas, fine lines, small type and logos.

1. Make a sample with the abrasion-resistant foil and record temperature, pressure, speed and die.

1. Check the sample visually, by hand rub, by the defined rub test and after finishing.

1. Keep the approved sample, failed sample and unrubbed control sample.

1. Reconfirm when the paper lot, supplier material or production process changes.

## Acceptance checks for seasonal gift boxes, corporate gift packaging, luxury boxes and collectible boxed products

- colour and gloss match the approved artwork;

- solid areas do not show pinholes, missing transfer or local inconsistency;

- fine lines and small type remain clear;

- rubbing does not create obvious colour or metallic-layer loss;

- folding, die-cutting and assembly do not create peeling;

- the result can be reproduced consistently in production.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why is the freshly stamped appearance not enough?

Packaging continues through production, logistics and use. Initial gloss does not represent final handling durability.

### Is approximately 200 rub cycles a universal industry standard?

Do not assume so. The weight, tool, rubbing method, substrate and judgement criteria must be stated.

### Should the substrate be changed before adjusting the process?

Start with the failure pattern. Immediate transfer failure points to process or contact conditions; later flaking requires review of adhesion, surface treatment and foil compatibility.

### Can a supplier guarantee that every production run will never flake?

A responsible supplier should provide test conditions and sampling support, but the final result must be confirmed on the customer’s actual material and equipment.

## Conclusion

cover the use and acceptance checks for abrasion-resistant foil across gift-box design, assembly and distribution. For seasonal gift boxes, corporate gift packaging, luxury boxes and collectible boxed products, abrasion-resistant foil can improve appearance stability through real handling conditions when the test method and process are properly matched. PINTE can support selection, sampling and technical records using the customer’s actual material.

> **Evidence status**: The 4 lb and approximately 200-cycle information remains pending technical verification of the test report, sample photographs and acceptance criteria.
